content:
The giant Best Buy Labor Day sale is now live alongside Amazon’s massive event, and we still have the best price ever on AirTag 2, but we spotted this 16GB/1TB M5 MacBook Air at $240 off via the Apple refurb store if you’re quick. Today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break is also headlined by iPhone Air at $150 off (or as much as $359 off at Best Buy in open-box condition), iPhone 17 Pro models dropping to new Amazon all-time lows again at up to $285 off and some notable Apple Pencil Pro deals too. Grab yourself the new $9 Apple Polishing Cloth before it sells out and head below for more.

Best Buy’s giant 2026 Labor Day sale is now live: Apple, Android phones, appliances $1,100 off, TVs, more

Amazon’s massive 2026 Labor Day sale now live! Thousands of deals: Apple, Android, TVs, tech under $100, more from under $5

iPhone Air is $150 off this week, but ‘excellent’ open-box listings are up to $359 off at Best Buy

As part of its now live 2026 Labor Day Sale, Best Buy is delivering the best deal around on brand new unlocked iPhone Air units with just about every model at $150 off the list price. However, you can save even more than that right now with its “excellent” condition open-box units – they are up to $359 off the new list prices. Details below.

Firstly, here’s how pricing lands on brand new condition units:

  • iPhone Air 256GB $850 (Reg. $999)
  • iPhone Air 512GB $1,050 (Reg. $1,199)
  • iPhone Air 1TB $1,250 (Reg. $1,400)

These are the best deals we can find on brand new condition unlocked iPhone Air units right now from a reputable retailer. As a quick reminder, Amazon does not carry iPhone Air in new condition.

But as mentioned above, Best Buy is also delivering these unlocked units in “excellent” open-box condition right now at even lower prices. You can browse through all of the open-box listings on this page via the “More options” link on each model right here, but we have pulled some highlights below at up to $359 off the new list prices:

  • Open-box iPhone Air 256GB Space Black $807 (Reg. $999)
  • Open-box iPhone Air 512GB Sky Blue $840 (Reg. $1,199)
  • Open-box iPhone Air 512GB Space Black $997 (Reg. $1,199)

This 16GB/1TB M5 MacBook Air is $240 off via Apple refurb store (Likely to sell out quick)

This deal likely won’t last long – the official Apple refurb store has had a hard time keeping M5 MacBook Air models in stock as of late (these things sell quick). But you can now land the 16GB/1TB 13-inch configuration at $240 off the new list price.

The Apple Certified Refurbished Store is now offering the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB of RAM and the 1TB SSD down at $1,359 shipped.

  • Covered by Apple’s one-year limited warranty
  • Covered by Apple’s 14-day returns policy
  • AppleCare product can be purchased
  • Engraving and gift wrap not available for refurbished products
  • Supplies are limited

This is a regularly $1,599 configuration at $240 off the list price in the sliver colorway. As of right now, it is literally the only M5 MacBook Air you can buy there and we suspect it is going to sell out quickly at a price like this.

For comparison’s sake, this model is selling for $1,538 at Amazon in brand new condition and has never dropped below $1,419 since the price increases landed at retail.

Updating…

Best Buy has ‘excellent’ open-box Apple Pencil Pro units down at $77 today (40% off list price)

As part of the Amazon Labor Day sale, we are still tracking an Amazon Resale deal on Apple Pencil Pro down at $74 shipped. However, the Best Buy Labor Day event is now live as well and it has “excellent” condition open-box Apple Pencil Pro units at $76.99 shipped.

The Amazon Resale option is indeed a few bucks less, but that is also a Like New: Used unit. Amazon’s very best used unit, but still used.

The Best Buy “excellent” contain open-box unit might be lightly used as well – they are basically returns or in-store units – but Best Buy does say it “looks like new” and includes all parts and accessories.

All told, they are more than likely going to come in similar condition and are both great ways to secure a regularly $99 to $129 Apple Pencil Pro for a while lot less:

  • Apple Pencil Pro Best Buy open-box $77 (Reg. $129 new)
  • Apple Pencil Pro Amazon Resale $74 (Reg. $129 new)

Apple Pencil Pro carries a $129 list price at Apple, but it is more regularly closer to $99, and is now on sale at $97 via Amazon. That said, $99 is effectively the going rate on this thing as it has sold in that range for nearly a year now.

M6 Mac mini pre-order discounts live at Amazon ahead of delivery this month

Alongside the Labor Day sales now live at Best Buy and Amazon, we are moving closer to delivery day on the all-new M6 Mac mini and M5 Pro model. If you’re still considering a pre-order, scoop up the new $9 Apple Polishing Cloth before it sells out and check out the discounts Amazon is offering on Apple’s new Mac mini pre-orders.

We have already highlighted these deals in various posts as they went live, but we wanted to make sure they were all in one place and on the radar for folks still considering a pre-order ahead of this month’s delivery date:

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB $880 (Reg. $899)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB $1,070 (Reg. $1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB $1,299
  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB $1,669 (Reg. $1,699)

The only configuration Amazon carries that isn’t seeing some kind of discount right now is the 24GB M6 model. While these deals are clearly not massive by any means, we are talking about brand new Apple gear here that hasn’t even released yet. And if you’re going to be pre-ordering one without a trade-in, you might as well save you a few bucks for gas, coffee, or just to scoop up some of those new Polishing Cloths while they are still available.

Be sure to dive into this week’s massive Labor Day sales at Amazon and Best Buy, and then scope out all of the latest details on Apple’s new M6 and M5 Pro releases below:

iPhone 17 Pro models drop to new Amazon all-time lows again at up to $285 off (Renewed Premium)

Alongside the Labor Day sale at Best Buy with deals on iPhone Air, and Amazon’s massive sale event, we are catching some solid discounts on iPhone 17 Pro as well. While not all color and configs are down quite as low as they were last week, we are now tracking new Amazon all-time low pricing on its best quality Renewed Premium iPhone 17 Pro models at up to $285 off. Apple will unleash the new iPhone 18 Pro models very soon, but you can bet they are going to be a whole lot more expensive than this.

As I have said previously, Amazon Renewed Premium units are the best way to land a deal on current-generation iPhone units, and especially iPhone 17 Pro right now. Apple does not sell them in the official refurb store, and even once it does, the prices are rarely ever as low as Amazon:

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,214 (Reg. $1,499 new) – New all-time low
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,214 (Reg. $1,499 new) – all-time low
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (Reg. $1,499 new)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,149 (Reg. $1,299 new) – New all-time low
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,165 (Reg. $1,299 new) – New all-time low
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,171 (Reg. $1,299 new)

All of these units come with a full 1-year Amazon Renewed Guarantee and “greater than 90% original battery life.” Just make sure you use the links above and watch out for third-party sellers otherwise.

Apple’s official MagSafe Battery just dropped to $59 low, or just $39 via Amazon Resale (Over 60% off)

Today’s accessories and charging deals:

  • Rare deal drops Lexar’s rugged 1TB ARMOR 700 SSD down to its lowest price since the hikes at $105 off
  • Labor Day Blink smart home deals: Score two indoor cams at $19 each, video doorbell for $48, more
  • Automate your floor cleaning with up to 50% Labor Day savings on roborock robot vacuums and mops starting from $140
  • This tiny Belkin 45W USB-C charger is a must-have in your EDC/travel kit, and it’s just $15 today
  • Belkin’s all-new dual-tone aluminum 25W Qi2.2 wireless MagSafe power bank just got its first deal for Labor Day at $77
  • Get or gift this universal airplane tray phone mount with build-in light for $9.50 (Save 21%)
  • Still live: Anker’s new SmartTrack Find My wallet card for iOS or Android drops to $25 Amazon all-time low
  • Whoa! LISEN’s Apple Watch charger with 20W adapter just fell further, now $9

Apple’s most affordable M4 iPad Air is $100 off at Amazon for Labor Day

While we are still tracking the lowest price ever on the latest AirTag 2 and the first discounts on the new M6 Mac mini as part of Amazon’s Labor Day sale, we are also getting some price relief on the most affordable M4 iPad Air too – it is now $100 off.

Amazon is now offering the 11-inch M4 iPad Air starting down at $649 shipped. Regularly $749, this is $100 off the list price and best we can find right now.

There have been a few extremely short-lived chances to land this machine for less recently, but those deals have come and gone faster than most folks could have even had a chance to score one.

The M4 iPad Air lineup, much like the rest of the current MacBook and iPad models, did recently catch a price hike. But with today’s deal, we are, at least, seeing some price relief here in the form for a $100 discount on the least expensive model you can buy. There are some of the much more expensive configs at $150 off right now, like the 1TB 13-inch model at $1,399, but $100 off is a solid price drop for the much less expensive models at this point.
